entries.en: I'm not talking about you!

entries.en: No, this is definitely thanks[n]to Futaba silencing Medjed.

entries.en: It's encouraging.
I'm worried.
Who cares?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Right? This shit's like,[n]the perfect motivation!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: C'mon, you too?[n]What're you saying!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Why the cold shoulder? These[n]people are cheering for us.
entries.uk: Чого так холодно? Ці люди[n]ж за нас уболівають.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Everyone's got high expectations[n]of the Phantom Thieves. Let's[n]make sure they're answered!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: On top of all that, this[n]case has shed light on[n]something important.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You mean that criminal.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Well... I suppose at this point[n]we can refer to them as the one[n]behind the mental shutdowns.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: That's the one who[n]killed my mom...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We can't leave them be.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Let's talk more in detail[n]about this tomorrow at school.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Crap.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hope I wake up in time.[n]When should I leave?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Uh, is that a joke?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What kind of lifestyle do[n]you lead?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Unbelievable.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I trust you know what will[n]happen if you're late?
